test_m3 = '''"""Test m3: @cache decorated function has .skip attribute for unified API."""

import pytest


def test_cache_has_skip_attribute():
    """The @cache wrapper must expose a .skip attribute."""
    from funcy.calc import cache

    @cache(timeout=60)
    def greet(name):
        return f"Hello, {name}!"

    assert hasattr(greet, "skip")


def test_cache_skip_is_callable():
    """.skip must be callable on the cache wrapper."""
    from funcy.calc import cache

    @cache(timeout=60)
    def double(x):
        return x * 2

    assert callable(double.skip)


def test_cache_skip_returns_value_without_caching():
    """Raising cache.skip(value) should return value without caching it."""
    from funcy.calc import cache

    call_count = [0]

    @cache(timeout=60)
    def expensive(x):
        call_count[0] += 1
        raise cache.skip(x * 100)

    result = expensive(7)
    assert result == 700
    assert call_count[0] == 1

    # Call again - should recompute since skip bypasses cache
    result2 = expensive(7)
    assert result2 == 700
    assert call_count[0] == 2


def test_cache_skip_does_not_pollute_cache():
    """When cache.skip is raised, the value must not be stored in cache."""
    from funcy.calc import cache

    call_count = [0]

    @cache(timeout=60)
    def compute(x):
        call_count[0] += 1
        raise cache.skip(x + 999)

    compute(1)
    compute(2)
    compute(3)

    # All calls should have recomputed (no caching of skipped values)
    assert call_count[0] == 3
'''

with open("crucible_hidden/test_m3.py", "w") as f:
    f.write(test_m3)
print("Rewritten test_m3.py")
